cohort: Postpartum women who delivered consecutive infants at the study hospital and participated in universal PPD screening between June 2008 and March 2010.
finding: While a prior negative EPDS screening significantly reduced the risk of a subsequent positive EPDS, stillbirth in a subsequent pregnancy was strongly associated with an increased risk of postpartum depression.
followup_time: Up to 2 years (duration between subsequent births within the study period)
